description: This file contains the implementation of the Zone model class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to retrieve zone details by zone ID, fetch zones by country ID with caching, and count total zones by country ID.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: A model class responsible for retrieving zone data from the database, including methods to get specific zone information, list zones by country, and count zones by country.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific zone based on its ID, including joins with zone description and filtering by language and status.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Fetches all zones associated with a given country ID, utilizes caching to optimize repeated requests, sorted by zone name.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the count of zones associated with a specified country ID where the status is active.
